observationSource: Explicit main verification thread handoff. This evidence collector did not launch the probes, inspect user registry keys or operate native UI; it records the limited reported observations without publishing private keys, SID, paths or screenshots.
rootReportedObservations: The same no-delete diagnostic executable passed from the command line and rejected when double-clicked through Explorer.
The first failure was the HKCU InstallLocation read returning an empty value; path and directory-tree validation had not yet executed.
Read-only probes reported the same SID digest, both 32-bit and neither having package identity.
Command-line probes could open the isolated test installation HKCU/HKU keys in both registry views (result 0); the Explorer-launched probe reported RegOpenKeyEx result 2 for the same keys.
conclusion: Launch-context or registry visibility differences remain under investigation. The c4 short-path compatibility fix cannot be claimed to resolve the original user failure.
